notes_for_editor: No build date, staffing, public access or present status found in the sources read. The record's location (33.2647, -93.3575) and height (33.5 m) agree with the NGS datasheet (NAD 83 position about 33.2646 N, 93.3574 W; 110 ft overall). Two Facebook results (a Columbia County Historical Society group post and a personal post recalling visitors climbing the tower in the 1970s) would not open and are not used. The 1950 directions end at a driveway; no source says whether that route or the site is open today, so no access level is recorded. A site check is needed before any status or access is stated.
